newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ramayana sees slightly higher 1996 net.
newsitem.headline: Ramayana sees slightly higher 1996 net.

text.p: Indonesian department store operator PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa said on Wednesday its net profit 1996 would be 67 billion rupiah, slighty higher than the company's previously announced target.
"Our net profit target for 1996 was 61.5 billion rupiah. But indications show that we will book 67 billion rupiah," Ramayana's corporate secretary Hardjanto Salim told Reuters.
He said it seemed that total sales would also be higher than expected.
"There are indications that total sales will reach 865 billion rupiah, higher than our target of 850 billion rupiah," he added.
Salim said the audited final 1996 results were scheduled to be announced before the end of March.
He also said the company was scheduled to hold a roadshow before the end of this month in Singapore, Hong Kong, the United States and Europe.
"We will only be updating Ramayana investors abroad," he said, and denied market speculation of a possible private placement.
Salim also denied talk of a possible affiliation with a foreign partner to expand its business.
